BiblicalUsage: Haggiah was the son of Shimea, named once in the genealogy of the Levites — Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son. His name sits between his father and his son, and that is all the record keeps of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in a genealogy is never filler: Haggiah is kept because the line was kept, and the line was kept because God keeps His own.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
